verdict.rationale: Superset's core work product (code changes) lives in ordinary Git worktrees/branches and is integrated via standard branches and PRs, and the tool is described as local-first with code staying on your machine unless shared — this gives inherent portability for the coding artifacts. However, there's no explicit documentation of exporting other Superset-managed data (tasks, automations, workspace configs, project metadata) in an open format, nor any 'leave/export all data' feature or independent confirmation of full data portability. Missing for 10: explicit data-export tooling for non-code metadata (tasks/automations/projects), documented open-format export of full account data, independent verification of lock-in-free exit.
